note: Pinned upstream sources for the Phase 1 targets. .github/workflows/targets.yml fetches them, verifies sha256 and mirrors them as releases src-<name>-<version>. An empty sha256 or commit means: not pinned yet; the sources job prints the value it found and fails until it is pinned here (trust on first use, recorded in docs/status/phase-1.md).
